items.text: the water is split in two. The shelf under the bar keeps the waters themselves (Shallows, Deep, Harbor…): tap one, tap it again for dry. Its settings moved up into a Water tab in the Sound panel, in two groups, Sound (depth, bed, voices) and Surface (its kind, what makes the ripples, its colors)
no more "none" and "both" choices. Voices are two switches, touch and music: light either, both, or neither for no voices. Bed and surface clear when you tap the lit one again
a shelf is as wide as its icons and sits centred over the button that opened it, instead of a wide box with the icons at one end; it still stays on screen, and scrolls when it has more than fits
Current keeps a short diary of the sound (what started, stopped, muted or rebuilt it, and when the speaker turned on or off), and a bug report includes it, to find sound that stops by itself
a tap on a bar button counts once: on some touch screens one tap on the speaker turned the sound on and at once started the fade that turns it off
the sticker card glides when a panel pushes it up and glides back down when the panel closes, instead of jumping
choosing a beat or a bytebeat in the shelf under the bar keeps the mixer open; it closes when you switch to another panel or close it
a bug report now says exactly what the sound is doing (each source, the bed, your pack, the speaker, the mixer, the level coming out), to find a speaker that disagrees with what you hear

on a phone too, the share sheet's close is the one over the capture button. The close beside Save is gone, and the one at the top right appears only when the sheet is taller than the screen and has to scroll
on a computer the share sheet has one close, over the capture button (and Esc); the close beside Save and the one at the top right are gone there. A phone keeps them
tap the sticker card and it stays, swelling gently with a glow while the sticker is cut, then flies up into the share sheet, instead of going blank for a moment

choosing Sticker in the share sheet now shows the sticker's own choices there too: the frame (none, white, black, your color) and the extras (Brand, Text, QR, your words). A still sticker is made again as you choose; a moving one offers Record it again
